p: the prime appearing in the theorem statement
G: the finite group appearing in the theorem statement
n: the integer at least 1 such that the order of G is p^n
Z(G): the center of G, consisting of the elements commuting with every element of G
C_G(x): the centralizer of x in G, namely the subgroup of elements of G that commute with x
Orb_G(x): the orbit of x under the conjugation action of G on itself
Stab_G(x): the stabilizer of x under the conjugation action of G on itself
r: the number of non-singleton conjugacy orbits of G
x_i: a chosen representative of the i-th non-singleton conjugacy orbit
